description: This Java class handles the undo approval command for share accounts in the Fineract project. It is a service component that processes commands to revert the approval state of share accounts by invoking a corresponding method in the ShareAccountWritePlatformService.

classes.name: UndoApproveShareAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: Handles the undo approval command for share accounts, integrating with the ShareAccountWritePlatformService to perform the undo operation.

fields.name: shareAccountWritePlatformService
fields.description: Service to handle share account write operations, injected via constructor.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the undo approval command by delegating to the service to perform the undo operation.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Executes the undo approval operation on the share account using the provided JSON command.
